factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The increase is attributable to higher production, but is simultaneously negatively impacted by lower average prices as a result of a higher share of electricity sold to the grid, as well as revised tariffs during the second half of the year and a weaker currency.'

factual_claims.claim: Currency movements reduced total revenue by SEK 18.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'Currency effects impacted revenues by SEK -18.0 (-4.5) million.'

factual_claims.claim: Subsidies contributed SEK 32.7 million and represented a significant portion of other operating income.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income Statement: Other operating income SEK 36,476 thousand (2025), with subsidies noted as SEK 32,667 thousand in Note 4.

factual_claims.claim: Operational capacity expanded by 55.7 MW during the year, reaching 395.8 MW across 216 solar installations at year-end, compared with 340.1 MW across 200 installations in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'In 2025, the company installed a total of 55.7 (57.5) MW... and had 395.8 (340.1) MW installed... at the end of the year.'

factual_claims.claim: Electricity production increased 30% to 327.8 million kWh, contributing to an estimated reduction of approximately 161,000 tonnes of CO2-related emissions.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'During the year, 327.8 (252.6) million kWh were produced... reducing CO2-related emissions by approximately 161,000 (124,000) tonnes.'

factual_claims.claim: The company signed 17 contracts representing 41.8 MW of capacity, although signed orders at year-end declined to 18.9 MW from 38.8 MW.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The company signed 17 (15) contracts representing total installed capacity of 41.7 (56.6) MW... At the end of 2025, the company had 18.9 (38.8) MW in signed orders.'

factual_claims.claim: Profitability improved despite higher operating costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: Operating profit increased to SEK 73.5 million (21.1% increase) while acknowledging higher operating expenses.

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses increased 5.5% to SEK 166.2 million, primarily because the larger installed base resulted in higher depreciation and maintenance costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income Statement: Operating expenses SEK 166,177 thousand (2025) vs 157,587 thousand (2024). Board of Directors' Report attributes increase to 'higher scheduled depreciation and increased maintenance'.

factual_claims.source_value: SEK 163,733 thousand (12.3% increase), margin from 67% to 68%

factual_claims.claim: Operating profit increased 21.1% to SEK 73.5 million, and the EBIT margin improved from 28% to 31%.

factual_claims.claim: Financing remained a key issue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Risk Factors section and CEO Comments highlight financing as a critical risk and strategic priority.

factual_claims.claim: The company expanded its refinancing agreement with Agricultural Bank Financial Leasing by SEK 372 million, at an interest rate of 3.60% and with ten-year amortization, while the SOLT4 bond was extended to November 8, 2026.

factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report: 'The company has entered into an agreement with...
